correctness.rationale: Reconstructed synchronous threshold-two Greenberg–Hastings rules for every q>=4 and simple wheel W_n, including n=3,4 cyclic index collisions. By analyzing excited sites at time one and two, the only time-two births are rim five-letter motifs with initial hub color 1 or a hub birth with initial hub q-1 and at least two initial 101 rim triples; these mechanisms cannot generate third-time excitement. The q and q+1 hitting-time cutoffs follow from q-1 refractory steps. The 4-symbol de Bruijn transfer counts labelled cyclic rim words with multiplicity q-3 for collapsed colors, giving exact maximal-shell populations and Bernoulli block argument gives limit 2/q. Independently enumerated the complete 256, 1024, 4096 and 3125 states for (q,n)=(4,3),(4,4),(4,5),(5,4): maximal times 4,5,5,6 and terminal counts 0,10,15,10; no time-three excitation or motif mismatch. This small enumeration corroborates but does not replace the all-q,n symbolic proof.
